propositions: The axis divergent_implementation fires on only 7.72% of plan-v3 findings and was never calibrated with worked examples, leaving 90% of omitted-scope findings graded none despite representing real plan divergence.
A G6 finding with validity 0.8889 that should block lands ADVISORY because all seven impact axes score none, resulting in impact_plan=0.0, which falls below the 0.60 blocking threshold.

The ordinal grading ladder (none|low|medium|high) masks semantic differences: omitting a required scope site is load-bearing divergence, while omitting documentation is cosmetic, but both today score identically.

Replacing ordinal grades with a closed Literal set (contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration, none) floors the first two at 0.85 and allows incomplete_enumeration below every blocking threshold, requiring exclusion from _SEV01 and its own DIVERGENCE_GRADE01 map.

A structural change to impact_plan must exclude divergent_implementation from the generic _SEV01 contribution loop and floor-checking to prevent symbolic grades being scored as 0.0, requiring introduction of _PLAN_GRADED_AXES to keep axes graded by kind consistent between contribution and override logic.

ADR 0054 rejects high-cost LLM-calibration (purpose-built eval suites, bulk re-review) in favor of zero-marginal-cost forms: offline corpus replay and normal-use dogfooding, narrowing ADR 0036 while preserving version-segmentation and permissive-rollout invariants.
